text:
Renee (partnerships): Hey team, starting coordination for CloudWave partnership to bring up a new region: ap-southeast-eco1. Main asks: marketplace SKU setup, capacity quotas, KMS/HSM access, and a short joint runbook. Who can own what?
Marco (cloud-ops): I'll own quota + test cluster. Planning request for 6xA100, 12xT4 as initial reserved capacity. Will file quota request today.
CloudWave (partner): We can publish a marketplace SKU and provide an onboarding image. KMS note: we need HSM-backed keys for customer tenant encryption. Is FIPS required?
Nadia (eng-runtime): FIPS 140-2 level 2 is expected for keys. Also we'll need kernel tuning (isolcpus and hugepages) for our runtime; can ops provide a short-lived test pool?
Sam (sales): Can we aim for a soft launch w/ partners in first week of June? Marketing will need co-brand copy and logo clearance two weeks prior.
Renee (partnerships): Soft launch first week of June sounds OK if legal + infra timelines align. Marco, what's ETA for quota and test pool?
Marco (cloud-ops): Quota ticket submitted: INC-89214. Typical approval 5-9 business days. I can spin a 2-node validation cluster in partner sandbox by May 5 for tuning.
CloudWave (partner): We'll send SKU entitlement matrix (base units, burst, metering) and IAM snippets for KMS access. Request service account with kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt and kms:CreateCryptoKeyVersion.
Nadia (eng-runtime): Once test cluster is up we'll run two quick checks: 1) runtime latency profile (p50/p95 p99) under 500/800/1200 concurrent sessions, 2) model quality baseline against our quantized build. Our smoke command: 
```
./smoke_test --region ap-southeast-eco1 --models=gpt-small,gpt-quant --concurrency=800 --duration=8m
```
Marco (cloud-ops): Noted. Also need marketplace entitlement numbers to gate scheduling and autoscale. CloudWave, confirm base/burst counts.
CloudWave (partner): Entitlements: base=40 units, burst up to 140 for month 1-3, then scale to negotiated levels. We'll attach metering doc now.
Renee (partnerships): Legal: please prepare co-branding terms. Sam, can you chase? Also add a 14-day embargo window for partner assets prior to public release.
Sam (sales): On it. I'll loop in legal and design. Expect logo clearance by May 20 and PR draft by May 24.
infra-bot: Security scan: partner image accepted; vulnerability check passed (critical=0, high=1).
Nadia (eng-runtime): After test runs I'll define a canary fallback: if p95 > 900ms for 10m, route traffic to fallback region (eu-west-1). Ops, can we implement automated route failover?
Marco (cloud-ops): Yes, we'll configure routing policy: fallback=eu-west-1, threshold=900ms, window=600s. I'll add to runbook.
CloudWave (partner): For logs/traces, we can forward debug logs to a shared bucket with 30d retention. We'll provide IAM to write objects.
Renee (partnerships): Action list: Marco -> INC-89214 + test cluster by May 5; CloudWave -> SKU + IAM + logs bucket; Nadia -> smoke tests + canary config; Sam -> legal/logo/PR; Everyone -> review and comment on runbook by Friday.
Nadia (eng-runtime): I'll upload smoke test results and a small ops checklist for post-launch health checks.
Marco (cloud-ops): I'll update the ticket with topology and quota payload. Example payload: {"region":"ap-southeast-eco1","resources":[{"type":"A100","count":6},{"type":"T4","count":12}],"purpose":"partner launch"}
Sam (sales): Legal confirmed basic co-branding terms. PR timeline aligned with May 24 draft.
CloudWave (partner): Sending SKU + IAM doc now; please invite our engineer to partner sandbox.
Renee (partnerships): Great, thank you. Ping me directly if anything blocks the timeline. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Reminder: kernel tuning maintenance window proposed May 7 01:00-03:00 UTC (pending ops approval).
